verses.text: Which in his times he shall show, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords, to whom be honor and power everlasting;
Whom no man hath seen, nor can see, unto whom no man can approach, only he who hath the light and the hope of immortality dwelling in him.

title: JST, 1 Timothy 6:15–16. Compare 1 Timothy 6:15–16 Those who have the light of immortality (the gospel) dwelling in them can see Jesus.
